data.name: Hanin
data.long_meaning: The name Hanin is derived from the Arabic root h-n-n which means 'to be kind', 'to be gracious', or 'to be charming'. It is a beautiful name with spiritual connotations, evoking feelings of kindness, generosity, and grace.
